title: Public Behaviour
learningGoal: Teach parents how to guide behaviour in public settings using preparation, clear expectations, and calm responses.
microLesson: Public behaviour challenges often come from overstimulation, boredom, or unclear expectations. Preparing children ahead of time, offering choices, and praising positive behaviour reduces stress for everyone.
activity: Before your next outing, set one clear expectation. Reflect on how your child responded.
